item.title: DevPulse 0.12.0
item.description:
• In the quick launcher, move to a ticket or a pull request and rest there for half a second: it expands. A ticket shows its pull requests (yours, and those GitHub finds with its key in your repositories) and its related tickets; a pull request shows its ticket and that ticket's related tickets. The arrow keys move into the indented rows, and Enter opens one.
  • The mouse moves the launcher's selection too.
